lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\NcwMailtemplate\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.
3 uses of the private API of the server in 1 file. Only OCP and NCU are public: what is below OC changes without notice between majors.

lines: The OpenAPI specification and the routes differ in 1 operation. A client generated from the specification then calls what is not there, or lacks what is. This holds the routes against the specification and does not generate it again.
